title: BTS Gear Up For ‘BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ IN BUSAN: LIVE VIEWING’ With New ‘Swim’ Teaser Trailer
summary: The 30-second preview comes ahead of the group's June 13 homecoming gig.
contentText:
BTS dropped the latest trailer for their upcoming BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ IN BUSAN: LIVE VIEWING on Friday morning (June 5), revealing the latest glimpse at the K-pop supergroup’s upcoming performance at South Korea’s Busan Asiad Main Stadium.

The 30-second preview of the group’s eagerly anticipated homecoming show on June 13 — which happens to coincide with the anniversary of the band’s debut — finds Jung Kook, Jimin, V, Suga, RM, Jin and J-Hope stalking the stage in black leather outfits over the strains of their Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 smash “Swim,” from their comeback album, ARIRANG .

The global live cinema event at the 53,000-capacity venue will screen in theaters around the world next Saturday. Tickets for the screening are on sale now; click here to find a theater near you and buy tickets. In addition, Fandango is offering a special exclusive $55 bundle that includes a movie ticketas well as an exclusive 18″ x 24″ holographic poster.

In support of their ARIRANG LP, BTS already aired live shows from Goyang and Toyko in cinemas in April and their Busan performance will mark their first show at the stadium since announcing their temporary hiatus from music in 2022 to complete their mandatory South Korean military service. The ongoing BTS WORLD TOUR ‘ARIRANG’ will unfold across 11 months and include 80 concerts in 34 cities.

Following the June 13 show, the group will move on to stadium gigs in Madrid, Brussels, London, Munich and Paris before taking a brief break on July 19 to perform at the FIFA World Cup Final halftime show at MetLife Stadium in New Jersey alongside Shakira and Madonna.
